acceptance_criteria: `Parameter` gains `expr: Option<String>`, the source text the user typed. `None` means a plain value (today's behavior). Existing constructors leave it `None`, and every existing test passes unchanged.

`Document::set_param_expr(name, src) -> Result<(), ModelError>` parses `src` and stores it, then re-evaluates the table. It returns an error, and leaves the document exactly as it was (all names, values and expressions), when: the parameter is unknown; `src` doesn't parse (the error carries the `ExprError`); the expression names a parameter that doesn't exist; it would create a cycle (`ModelError::ParameterCycle(Vec<String>)` naming the parameters on the cycle in order, e.g. `a = b + 1 mm`, `b = a` gives `["a", "b"]` or a rotation of it); or the result's dimension doesn't match the parameter's unit (see the next item). A self-reference (`a = a + 1 mm`) is a cycle.

Units: a parameter whose `unit` is `mm`, `cm`, `m`, `in` or `ft` expects a length, `deg` or `rad` an angle, and an empty unit a unitless number. A unitless result for a length or angle parameter is taken in that parameter's unit (`5` typed into an `mm` parameter is 5 mm; into a `deg` parameter, 5°). `Parameter::value` stays in the parameter's own unit, so existing callers of `param()` see the same numbers. Test: `d0 = 40` (mm), `d1` (mm) `= d0 / 2 + 5 mm` gives 25 ± 1e-12; `w` (in) `= 1 in` gives 1.0 ± 1e-12; `ang` (deg) `= 90 deg` gives 90 ± 1e-9; `d1 = 2 deg` is a dimension error.

`Document::evaluation_order() -> Vec<String>`: every parameter, each after the parameters its expression names, ties broken by creation order. Test: `c = a + b`, `b = a * 2`, `a = 3 mm`, created in the order `c`, `b`, `a`, give `[a, b, c]`.

Re-evaluation: `set_param(name, value)` on a parameter that others depend on updates them all. Test: `d0 = 40 mm`, `d1 = d0 / 2`, `d2 = d1 + d0`; `set_param("d0", 60.0)` gives `d1` = 30 and `d2` = 90, each ± 1e-12. `set_param` on a parameter that has an expression replaces the expression with the plain value (`expr` becomes `None`).

`dirty_after_param_change(name)` also covers features that read a parameter which depends on `name` through expressions. Test: in the `block_and_shaft` fixture, make `thickness` = `base_t * 2`; the features dirty after a change to `base_t` equal those dirty after a change to `thickness`.
`rename_param(old, new)` also rewrites `old` in every stored expression, as a whole identifier only (`d1` → `width` changes `d1 / 2` but not `d10`). Values are unchanged afterwards.
New `ModelError` variants have clear `Display` messages. No panics on any input; a test runs at least 10 invalid `set_param_expr` calls and checks the document is unchanged after each.
No `unsafe`; no new dependencies; `swx-core` still has no workspace dependencies.
`cargo fmt --all --check && cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings && cargo test --workspace` passes.
QA report (FACTORY §6b) posted on the PR.
objective.description: M2-08b: Parameter table stores expressions: dependency ordering, cycle detection and re-evaluation on change
